photos.c: Mal Robinson wins the 2 miles (right) at the Southwestern relays Louisiana in 8:54.8 just three hours after running an anchor mile in a medley relay in a sizzling 4:06.5. At the same meeting, Pennel just failed to beat the world record pole-vault and Edward Red threw the javelin 260'-7½". Robinson and Red (left) were awarded the outstanding athlete trophies. A few weeks later Mal strode to the U.S.A.'s best Collegiate 2 mile time of the year clocking 8:49.8
